title: Izge: show the discovery
question: Choose the visual direction. Concept images only; labeled demo evidence, not a revenue claim.

options.label: The missing connection
options.thesis: Three ordinary records align to reveal work missing from the invoice.
options.viewport: Contract, delivery and invoice align into a reviewable finding.
options.risk: Must feel like discovery, not accounting software.

raised.raise: Keep source identities clear until they connect.
Give the discovery one unmistakable focal point.
Keep foreground evidence still and readable.
Give each step an explicit consequence.
Keep the story together rather than fragmenting features.
Use asymmetry with a clear reading sequence.

options.label: The moment Izge notices
options.thesis: A consequential finding enters the working day.
options.viewport: A discovery opens inside an active workspace with sources and a team response.
options.risk: Familiar premium software language; avoid another chat hero.

options.label: Color counterpoint
options.thesis: Overlapping source lanes reveal the discrepancy.
options.viewport: Overlapping source lanes reveal the discrepancy.

options.kept: Keep source identities clear until they connect.
